content:
Alex: FYI opened PR to unify KMS/HSM examples across private/VPC and add an offline signing section. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2477
Maria: Nice. The transit-gateway -> peering migration note needs clarity: some customers use both.
Alex: I'm drafting a short decision table and an ASCII flow to show egress path.
Alex: ASCII:
``` 
Client -> VPC (redwood) --(egress)-> Transit Gateway -> On-prem NAT -> HSM
or
Client -> VPC (redwood) --(peering)-> On-prem VPC -> HSM
```
Jia: For host firewalls: we've historically shown iptables examples; can we include nftables + minimal iptables fallback? I'll paste both.
Jia: nftables (debian11 tested):
```
table inet redwood_kms {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
  chain forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy accept; }
}
add rule inet redwood_kms input tcp dport 23456 ct state new,established accept
add rule inet redwood_kms input ip saddr 10.2.0.0/16 tcp dport 23456 accept
```
Jia: iptables (fallback):
```
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 23456 -s 10.2.0.0/16 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
```
Sam: Offline bundle notes: include `gpg --verify` and also `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz` for customers who prefer openssl.
Sam: Also show example for importing CA into system trust on RHEL: `sudo cp ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ && sudo update-ca-trust extract`
Tess: Small editorial: canonicalize heading case to HSM (uppercase) and use "Transit Gateway" consistently.
Alex: Good call. Also adding a systemd tip to keep the kms-proxy stable on flaky networks:
```
# override for redwood-kms-proxy
[Service]
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStartSec=30
LimitNOFILE=65536
```
Maria: Can you also add a short migration snippet for customers moving from peering to transit-gw (routes + BGP note)?
Alex: Adding a sample route table diff and BGP AS placeholder. Will avoid any carrier-specific IPs.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck failed -> docs/private/kms-links.md has a dead anchor '#peering-migration' (404) job #612
Alex: Pushing a commit to add the anchor and cross-ref. Also adding a backport to `release/1.1.x` for older installer docs.
DocsBot: CI: lint found inconsistent heading levels in docs/onprem/install.md -> warnings only
Jia: I'll fix the HSM headings and standardize capitalization.
Maria: Happy to review once you're ready. I'll pay special attention to the peering vs tg wording.
Alex: Pushed fixes. Running tests.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed, linter warnings resolved.
Sam: After merge, can we add a short 'what's new' snippet to the changelog so support can forward to customers?
Alex: Yes adding an entry: "docs: added offline verification, nftables, systemd hints, peering->Transit Gateway migration guide (backported v1.1)".
Tess: Quick security note: ensure we don't publish real PKCS#11 slot IDs or production role ARNs. Use placeholders like `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-hsm`.
Alex: Will scrub any sensitive examples. Thanks everyone.
Maria: :thumbsup:
DocsBot: PR merged and backported to release/1.1.x. Closing thread.
